description: Scroll the screen repeatedly until a target element is found. Performs a swipe gesture, then checks the UI hierarchy for the target. Repeats until found or max iterations reached. Useful for finding elements in long lists or scrollable content.

contentDesc.description: Match elements with this content-description (partial, case-insensitive)

direction.description: Scroll direction (default 'down' = content moves up, revealing lower items)

resourceId.description: Match elements with this resource-id (partial match)

tapWhenFound.description: Automatically tap the element when found

name: adb_scroll_until
